name: Junya Watanabe
why: Reworked workwear and denim — patchwork, hybrid pieces, collaborations with Levi's, Carhartt and The North Face — from a Comme des Garçons designer.
origin: Junya Watanabe has had his own line within Comme des Garçons since 1992.

onething.n: SSENSE designer page; via Mr Porter

notes.denim: patchwork denim and sanctioned Levi's rebuilds — the collaboration as art form
notes.style: the remix as a design philosophy — familiar icons made strange
notes.avant: the remix as formal invention — familiar icons made strange
notes.weird: Spliced garments and seams that should not close. The weirdness is engineering — a technical problem set and then solved in public.
